welcome_text: Hello! My name is Ingrid Bianchi
who_i_am: From commercial strategist to full stack developer with a product vision

I used to live between campaigns, multidisciplinary teams and marketing boards, always looking for the most efficient way to connect with people. Until one day I thought: "What if I take that obsession with understanding the user to the tech world? "

Today I design and develop digital solutions that not only work: they make people fall in love. I merge a solid backend with user-centered UX/UI design, and translate business needs into scalable, secure and maintainable technology.

My differential: a 360° vision that unites empathy, architecture and strategy. I analyze the market, the competition and the context before writing the first line of code. With experience in e-commerce, CRM, bots, APIs and automation, every project I touch seeks real impact.
I am passionate about transforming ideas into interactive systems that solve, engage and evolve. Every bug resolved, every optimized flow, is a step towards something great.
